title: Beechcraft Bonanza A36 — Normal Operating Procedures
description: Normal operating procedures for the Beechcraft Bonanza A36 with Continental IO-550 fuel-injected engine, constant-speed propeller, and retractable tricycle gear. Covers preflight walk-around through shutdown and securing. All airspeeds, power settings, fuel quantities, manifold pressure values, and performance data must be taken from the specific aircraft POH. The IO-550 is fuel-injected — there is no carburetor heat. The fuel selector has three positions (LEFT, RIGHT, OFF); confirm the selected tank before every phase. The A36 has an emergency landing-gear extension handle; familiarise yourself with its location before flight. Not a substitute for qualified instruction or type-specific checkout.

source.notes: No manufacturer document consulted. Written from general familiarity with the type.

known_issues.description: Contains no airspeeds, power settings, fuel quantities, or other numerical limitations — all must come from the specific aircraft POH.
Equipment and avionics vary across A36 airframes. Verify every item against the specific aircraft and its POH before use.

rights.notes: Manufacturer POH remains under copyright. This file does not reproduce its wording or selection of items.
